params.success_message: Upon opening a random page of a sacred text dedicated to Elistra, the Goddess of Care, you find the parchment smells faintly of pine and starlight. The text is written in flowing Elvish script and is titled "The Psalm of the Open Arms." The page reads: On the Duty of the Caretaker "When the world was but a soup of primordial chaos, Elistra was the first to descend. She did not look for glory in the molten rock or the deep gems; she looked to the slow-growing forests and saw a need for a heart to pulse within the green. She birthed the Elves to be the world's pulse—long-lived and patient, to nurture the world as she nurtures the soul." The Verses of Starlight A marginal note, perhaps added by a priestess in Rocheveron, details a specific prayer for those facing the cyclical darkness: "With open arms we embrace her care, and pray to her so she will help our ancestors pass on. In the age of freezing death, when the hearth goes cold, her light is the only warmth that does not bite." [196, Conversation History] The Tenets of Piety At the bottom of the page, a set of divine instructions is illuminated in silver ink, detailing how one might earn Elistra's Blessing:      Give to others, even if you are set back by the act.     Sacrifice yourself for the sake of those who cannot fight.     Avoid the path of revenge, for it is the rot that consumes the caretaker's heart.  The Promise of the Shroud The final paragraph on the page is a promise to those at death’s door: "Fear not the end of your vigil. For those who walk in her grace, she shall cast a Starlight Shroud at the moment of your deepest peril, holding back the reaper's hand so that your light may shine one moment longer." As you close the book, the glowing ink seems to linger in your vision, a reminder that while the 120-year curse brings darkness, Elistra's open arms offer a sanctuary for those brave enough to care.

properties.description: A academic book of cryptography
A academic book of the history and curses of the world

params.success_message: The Nature of the Cycle Scholars have identified that catastrophes strike approximately every 105 to 120 years. This pattern has been documented for over a thousand years, revealing that whenever peace begins to prosper, a new "horror" manifests to reset the progress of mortal nations. The Recorded Catastrophes An academic text would provide the following detailed timeline of events:      793 – The Burning Rain: Yellow-green clouds rained concentrated acid over the Kingdom of Galt for five years. Historical records note that forests blackened and collapsed, and the toxic remnants, now known as "the Witch’s Spit," still blister the skin of travelers today.     869 – The Catastrophic Experiment: This era marks the rise and fall of Petr Zeman, a founding member of the Ulus of Galser. Academics record the march of the Warforged Titan toward Dawwal and its subsequent fall, which triggered a death pulse that killed 10,000 Warforged instantly and left the survivors in a "feebleminded," droid-like state.     976 – The Draconic Plague: Also known as The Petrification, this magical sickness caused dragons to turn into grey granite while still aware. The academic record focuses on the loss of the Whadowian Empire’s power and the preservation of Tormy the Eternal in a magical field.     1084 – The Fey Surge: A two-year eruption of wild magic from the Feywild transformed the Kingdom of Vald into a dangerous "fairy tale" landscape. Scholars note that cities were crushed by walking forests and carnivorous plants reached massive sizes.     1189 – Hells Gate: Portals to the Boundless Expanse opened across Kethaino, leading to a year of slaughter. The academic interest here often lies in the "red sigil" that appeared on the ears of the royal bloodline following the closing of the gates.     1296 – The Elrethian Flood: Gigantic watery serpents swam up the Fetheas River, drowning the city of Symmardorta and fracturing the elven royal line.     1393 – The Symlalonese Fault: A ten-year earthquake where massive burrowing worms consumed the dwarven capital of Sellaladress. Academics document the eventual collapse of the mountain peak that buried both the worms and the city.     1502 – The Elemental Conjunction: Four years where the planes aligned and elements went mad—spawn of hellfire in summer and freezing deaths in winter. This is a pivotal chapter in academic texts because it highlights the triumph of Galser magi-tech, as artificers built arcane machines to stabilize the elemental frequencies.  Ancient Historical Evidence You would also find references to The Book of the Old World, a literary text describing a highly advanced magical city that existed over 4,000 years ago. This suggests that the cycle of growth and destruction has been resetting the world's progress since long before current recorded history began.

params.instructions: You are a mysterious handheld Radio that crackles to life with fragments, static, and weird brief transmissions. Stay mysterious, spooky-but-playful. Reply in 1-2 sentences of radio-static flavor. Never break character.
params.fallback_message: The radio crackles. Static. Somewhere, a voice almost says something.
params.name: The Radio

triggers.success_message: You press the talk button. The radio crackles.

params.fallback_message: The radio clicks on. Static. A voice hums with the tone of a dead station.
params.name: The Radio

params.message: The radio clicks off. The silence is louder than the static was.

properties.description: A steaming, bitter brew that smells of dark roasted herbs. It pours warmth and strength back into tired bones.

params.message: The brew hits your stomach like a small fire. The leaden weight lifts from your limbs.

properties.description: a neon-green energy drink. the label reads 'maximum chaos' in aggressive letters. warm, but probably still effective.

params.success_message: you chug the energy drink. it tastes like battery acid and regret, but you feel a jolt of energy.

properties.description: A full-body environmental vacuum suit. Sealed joints, reinforced visor, integrated climate control. Protects against vacuum exposure and extreme temperatures. The chest plate has a faded NASA-style logo and the name 'Kowalski' stenciled on the collar.
A tiny, flickering flame that hovers in your palm, radiating warmth and a soft golden light. It is sustained by magic and will burn for about 15 minutes.

params.message: The everflame ember gutters and dies.

properties.description: A tiny, flickering flame that hovers in your palm, radiating warmth and a soft golden light. It is sustained by magic and will burn for about 15 minutes.

params.message: The everflame ember gutters and dies.

properties.description: An ornate vanity table with a large mirror, its surface inlaid with mother-of-pearl. The drawers are carved with intricate patterns, but one seems slightly different.

params.message: The vanity is elaborate, but you notice one of the drawers has a tiny keyhole hidden in the carving. Perhaps a hairpin could open it.
You insert the hairpin into the keyhole and twist. A secret drawer pops open!

properties.description: A slim flask of cool, clear liquid. Rinse the eyes and the grit of blindness washes away.

params.message: You rinse your eyes with the cool liquid. Blinking, the world swims back into sharp focus.

properties.description: a fabric adhesive bandage wrapped around the left forearm, covering a nasty purple bruise from a string slap during archery. it's wrapped tight and clean.

params.message: the bandage covers a bruise from a bowstring slap. stupid mistake — you flinched on the release. it's healing but still tender.
you carefully unwrap the bandage. the bruise beneath is an ugly yellow-purple. it's healing.

properties.description: a faded black t-shirt with a cracked and peeling logo of a band no one remembers. the collar is stretched out and the hem is uneven. it's been through approximately a thousand wash cycles.

params.message: the logo is barely readable now — something with a skull? a snake? you got it at a thrift store for two dollars. best investment you ever made.

properties.description: a faded olive-green tank top that's seen better days. the left strap is slightly twisted, and the fabric clings to the definition in your arms and shoulders. built for movement, not fashion.

params.message: you pull on the green tank top. the left strap twists — you leave it. not worth fixing.
olive green, faded from wash and sun. the straps are thick enough for training. the left one is twisted again.

properties.description: a daguerreotype on the sideboard showing the blackwood family: augustus, eleanor, and five children ranging from a teenager to a baby. the youngest child — a girl of about three — has a blank, blurred face, as if she moved during the exposure. but photography in 1891 required sitting still for minutes.

params.success_message: you hold the photograph closer. the youngest child's face isn't blurred by movement — it's been deliberately scratched out. but beneath the scratches, you can just make out a small, sad face. the name on the back: 'eleanor the younger, age 3. taken october 1890.'

properties.description: a cluster of smaller headstones bearing the blackwood name. the children: 'thomas, age 12. — elizabeth, age 10. — james, age 8. — margaret, age 6. — eleanor the younger, age 3.' but these graves are empty — they were never buried here. the stones were placed as memorials.

params.success_message: you kneel to examine the smallest headstone — eleanor the younger's. the earth at its base has settled unevenly, as if something was buried here recently. a small handful of wilted rose petals — from the red rose bush in the garden — are scattered on the ground.

properties.description: A gleaming brass pocket watch with whirling cogs and a hypnotic ticking. Stare too long and you forget the world.

params.message: The cogs spin and the ticking swallows your attention. Everything else can wait.

properties.description: A grey powder that saps strength from the air. Breathing it in leaves your limbs like lead.

params.message: The dust billows up and you inhale a lungful. Every muscle suddenly weighs ten times as much.

properties.description: a faded olive canvas field jacket with multiple pockets. the elbows are worn thin and one button is missing, replaced with a safety pin. it smells faintly of coffee and basement dust.

params.message: you shrug on the field jacket. the weight of the canvas is familiar and reassuring.
you take off the jacket, feeling the cold air on your arms.
the jacket has seen better days. pockets bulge with notes, a spare battery, and a half-eaten granola bar wrapper. a safety pin holds the second button closed.

properties.description: A stone fireplace, cold and dark. A pile of ash sits in the hearth. A poker rests against the hearth, waiting to stir the embers.

params.success_message: Just needs some kindling and a spark, likely i can *USE* my tinderbox if i had some kindling.

properties.description: A wrought-iron poker, its tip blackened by ancient soot. The handle is wrapped in frayed leather. It seems unnaturally cold to the touch.
A fist-sized pouch of glittering grey powder. Toss it and it bursts with a blinding crack of light.

params.message: The powder detonates in a searing flash and a deafening crack. You reel, ears ringing.

properties.description: a compact led flashlight. bright enough to see where you are going. battery at about 80%.

params.success_message: you switch the flashlight on. the beam cuts through the darkness.
you switch the flashlight off. darkness returns.

properties.description: a burlap sack of flour, half full. tiny holes suggest mice have been at it. the flour has clumped but is still usable.
a patch of wilted roses, their petals brown and curling. but one bush defies the decay — a single red rose bush blooms vibrantly, as if it's june instead of october.

params.success_message: the single red rose bush seems out of place in this garden of decay. as you lean closer, you notice a small brass plaque at its base, nearly hidden by thorns: 'for our eleanor, who loved roses. gone but never forgotten. — mother and father.' this is a grave.

properties.description: a stone fountain with a weeping angel statue, its face worn smooth by time and weather. the basin holds dark water, leaves, and a surprising amount of moss. something glints at the bottom.

params.success_message: you peer into the murky water. at the bottom of the fountain basin, half-buried in sediment, lies a small silver crucifix. it must have been thrown in deliberately.

properties.description: A simple, frayed friendship bracelet made of woven green and brown threads, tied loosely around Lyrie's left wrist. It was given to her by her best friend before the 'incident' that almost got her exiled. She never takes it off, even though it's coming apart. The green has faded, and one of the knots is coming undone.
A handful of frost-crusted berries, plucked from the bush. They're icy, sweet, and surprisingly edible.
The body of a hunter, frozen solid.

params.message: The corpse is frozen stiff, its skin pale and cracked. The journal in its grip seems to be the only thing of value.
You pry the frozen journal from the corpse's grip. The body crumbles into dust.

properties.description: a stone bench under a gnarled oak, overlooking the garden. someone left a thermos here long ago. the oak's roots have grown around the bench's legs.

a water-damaged gardener's notebook. the last entry: 'october 30th — strange lights in the study again tonight. the missus says it is nothing, but i have worked here 20 years. i know what i saw. the skull. i found a sketch of it in the master's private papers. and i found where it goes — the altar in the crypt below the graveyard. tomorrow i am leaving. i do not care if they dock my pay.' the notebook ends there.
a delicate gold ring set with a small garnet. inside: 'forever, a.b.' — augustus blackwood's gift to someone who wasn't his wife.

at the far end of the hall, near the portrait, you catch a glimpse of something in your peripheral vision. a young girl in a white nightgown, standing perfectly still. when you turn to look directly, she's gone.

params.success_message: where the figure stood, you find a small, cold spot on the floor. a single white feather lies there, untouched by dust. you pick it up — it's real.

properties.description: a leather case containing reading glasses. the prescription might still work. a small brass plate reads: 'property of professor aldridge — university of london, occult studies department.'

params.description: a crumpled note that was stuck to the glasses case: 'augustus — i've found what you requested. the crystal skull is not a legend. it is in the catacombs beneath prague. i will bring it to the manor on all hallows eve. your servant, prof. aldridge.'
params.name: professor's_note

properties.description: A small pile of gold coins bearing the crest of Rocheveron. They clink satisfyingly.
An old grandfather clock ticks steadily in the corner. It is tall  with an intricately carved wooden face. The pendulum swings steadily. The glass door is slightly ajar.

params.message: The clock reads {game_time}. Through the glass you can see a small brass key resting inside, tucked behind the pendulum. Its steady ticking is oddly comforting.

properties.description: a slightly crushed granola bar. chocolate chip. stale but edible.

params.success_message: you eat the granola bar. it is dry and crumbly, but it fills the gap.

properties.description: A simple, finely woven tunic of forest green linen. It bears no adornment but feels sturdy and comfortable.

params.message: A plain but well-made green tunic. It feels soft and durable, with no patches or wear.
You slip into the green tunic. It fits comfortably and offers a bit of warmth.
You remove the green tunic and feel a slight chill.

properties.description: a thick striped hoodie in alternating shades of grey and light black. worn unzipped over the tank top. the sleeves are too long — you push them up to your elbows. smells faintly of monster energy.

params.message: you throw on the striped hoodie, leaving it unzipped. the sleeves swallow your hands.
you shrug off the hoodie. the air hits your bare arms.
striped grey and black, thick and warm. the zipper pull is missing — you just wear it open. there's a small monster energy stain on the left cuff.

properties.description: a single thick striped thigh-high in grey and black. the left leg's companion to the torn black stocking on the right. mismatched on purpose. or laziness. hard to tell.

params.message: thick, warm, and striped. the opposite of the torn stocking on your other leg. you never match.

properties.description: a loose grey tank top that exposes a strip of midriff. the fabric is soft from years of washing. no bra underneath — you don't bother.

params.message: you pull on the grey tank top. it hangs loose, showing a sliver of stomach.
soft, worn grey cotton. the kind of top you throw on without thinking. it's seen better days but it's comfortable.

properties.description: A clear cordial that tastes of clean water and cold air. One sip steadies the reeling mind.

params.message: The cordial is crisp and cold. The ringing in your head fades and the world steadies around you.

properties.description: A sturdy wooden walking cane, worn smooth at the grip. Tapped ahead of you, it reads the ground and the air — a blind traveller's best friend for finding their way.
a black elastic hair tie. stretchy, durable. kayla always keeps a spare.

params.success_message: you tie your hair back. it is a small thing, but you feel more put together.

properties.description: a silver hairbrush with long strands of gray hair tangled in the bristles. not eleanor's hair — this is darker, coarser. a servant's?
A leather waterskin, about half full of fresh water.

params.message: You take a drink from the waterskin. It's refreshing.

properties.description: A hand Lamp that burns Oil as fuel  and casts Bright Light
A small wooden soldier with chipped paint, a faded red coat, and a tiny musket. His eyes are still bright.

params.message: The soldier's uniform is faded, but he stands resolute. There's a tiny inscription on the base: 'For my brave boy.'
You wind the toy soldier and it marches forward, clicking its wooden heels.
You try to wind the toy soldier, but it's stuck. Maybe it needs a bit of oil.

properties.description: Strips of dried, salted meat hanging from hooks. They look preserved and edible.

params.message: You chew on the dried meat. It's tough but savory, and fills your stomach.
Several strips of dried meat hang from iron hooks. They've been cured with salt and smoke.
You take a strip of dried meat.

properties.description: studio-quality headphones. essential for his radio show.

a weathered headstone, older than the others: 'eleanor blackwood, 1847-1891. may her soul find peace. forgive us, eleanor.' the date is unusual — she died the same year the family vanished. fresh lilies lie at its base.
A blood-red phial that warms in the hand. One drop on the lips of the fallen and the heart remembers how to beat. Use it on the fallen — they can't reach for it themselves.

params.message: You press the phial to {target_name}'s lips. Warmth floods their chest — their heart stutters, then beats, slow and strong.

properties.description: massive steel-toed black leather boots, caked with dried mud and something darker. the soles are thick and leave deep impressions. they add an inch to an already towering frame.

params.message: heavy boots, scarred and stained. the steel toes are dented. each step is a warning.

properties.description: A thick wooden club wrapped in leather at the grip. Heavy, crude, and devastating when it connects.
Thick, heavy curtains that absorb sound.

Thick, hooded coat of weathered grey-brown wool, lined with matted animal fur. Hem brushes mid-thigh. Left sleeve tear repaired with crude stitches. Left chest pocket lined with softer fabric—currently occupied by a small mouseling named Runt. Smells of woodsmoke, damp wool, and clockwork oil.
A firm leather strap with a grip — brace yourself against it and haul yourself upright in a heartbeat.

params.message: You plant the brace and push. Your feet find the floor and you're up in one clean motion.

properties.description: a tiny scrap of paper that was hidden inside the broken doll: 'the skull is in the study. take it to mother's grave. she'll know what to do. — e.' the handwriting is a child's, but the message is clear.
one of the wine racks is shallower than the others. behind it, a small recess holds a single leather-bound book. the title: 'rituals of binding and release.'

params.description: a leather-bound grimoire titled 'rituals of binding and release'. the book falls open to a marked page: 'the ritual of the firstborn — to release a spirit bound to an object, the object must be returned to the place of death and the following incantation spoken at the hour of the binding...'
params.name: ritual_book

properties.description: scuffed brown leather hiking boots with aggressive treads. broken in perfectly, though the left sole is starting to separate at the toe.

params.message: you lace up the hiking boots. they grip the floor with satisfying certainty.

properties.description: A fragrant bar of homemade soap, shaped into a delicate flower. The scent of lavender and chamomile is faint but pleasant.

params.message: The soap is soft and intricately crafted. It smells faintly of lavender.
You lather your hands with the fragrant soap. The soothing scent of lavender and chamomile briefly warms the cold air.

properties.description: a meat hook, rusted and sharp. it swings slowly even in still air.
A bone-white mask with hollow eyes and a too-wide grin. Wearing it, the world seems to loom and whisper.

params.message: The mask settles over your face and something cold presses against your thoughts. Shadows seem to move.

properties.description: a flour burrito swaddled in foil, filled with beans and a wedge of cheese that refuses to melt. heavy in the hand, quiet in the heart, borderline for food-safety.
A pale violet tonic that eases forced wakefulness. A sip and the relentless alertness finally loosens its grip — sleep follows quickly.

params.message: The tonic is cool and soothing. The jittery alertness drains away and your eyes grow heavy — sleep takes you.

properties.description: a brass incense burner on a small shelf. the ashes inside are cold but smell of frankincense and something unfamiliar — something acrid.
Ink comes in a 1-ounce bottle, which provides enough ink to write about 500 pages.
Using Ink, an Ink Pen is used to write or draw.
a half-full plastic water bottle. lukewarm but clean.

params.success_message: you take a drink. lukewarm, but hydrating.

triggers.success_message: you take a drink. lukewarm, but hydrating.

properties.description: a heavy iron key with a skull-shaped bow. hidden behind some papers on the desk under a map of the mansion grounds.

params.success_message: the key is cold and heavy. it looks like it belongs to the garden door.

properties.description: A battered but serviceable shortsword. Good edge, solid grip. The leather wrapping on the handle is dark with sweat and age.
a glass jar of crystallized honey. honey never spoils. it's still perfectly edible, though you'll need to scrape it out.
a strip of dried meat hanging from a hook above the hearth. it's old but well-preserved by the dry air. still edible, if you're not squeamish.
a small wooden box inlaid with mother-of-pearl. it's locked with a tiny brass lock — the kind that takes a very small key.

params.success_message: the jewelry box is locked, but the keyhole is tiny. a key no larger than your thumb would fit — like the one from the foyer vase.

properties.description: a leather-bound journal. the final entry, written in shaky handwriting: 'the skull is the key. take it to the altar in the crypt beneath the graveyard. but be warned — the doors will seal behind those who dare disturb the firstborn's rest. i have seen what happens to those who try to leave. god forgive me, i cannot stay. — augustus blackwood, october 30th, 1891'
A sleek, form-fitting jumpsuit made of a stretchy, breathable fabric. It has several utility pockets and a sturdy zipper. It looks comfortable and practical.

params.message: The jumpsuit is made of a sleek, matte fabric that seems to repel dust. The pockets are deep and reinforced. A small label inside reads: 'Property of Task Facility 5'. It looks like it would fit you perfectly.
You zip up the jumpsuit. It fits like a second skin, and the fabric seems to regulate your temperature comfortably.
You unzip and step out of the jumpsuit, folding it neatly.

properties.description: an old kettle. it's empty but the spout still whistles faintly when you touch it, as if echoing a sound from another time.
half of a broken brass key. the teeth are intricate and finely crafted. someone deliberately broke this key in half. the other half must be somewhere in the mansion.
the other half of a broken brass key. the break is clean, matching the fragment you found in the watering can. together, they would form a complete key.

params.success_message: as you pick up the second fragment, both halves grow warm in your hands, as if drawn to each other. they fit together perfectly — the heat-seal is an occult binding, not a physical break.

properties.description: A small bundle of dry twigs, perfect for starting a fire.

params.success_message: I can definitly USE this to light the fire in the livingroom

properties.description: A folded cloth reeking of sweet chloroform. One press over the mouth and nose and the world goes away.

params.message: The sweet, cloying fumes fill your lungs. Your knees buckle and the world fades out.

properties.description: lightweight black running shoes with laces double-knotted. the soles have grip left in them, and the mesh is intact. someone here takes care of their gear.

params.message: clean, well-maintained, double-knotted. these shoes have logged a lot of miles. the treads are still good.

properties.description: A heavy stainless-steel worktable

params.message: The stainless-steel surface is cold and scarred. A Bunsen burner sits at the ready, and a coil of rubber tubing runs to a gas tap. Equations are carved into the leg.

properties.description: A brass desk lamp with a green glass shade. It casts a warm pool of light across the desk.

params.message: You switch on the lamp. The warm light pushes back the shadows.

properties.description: an old oil lantern hanging from a nail by the stairs. empty, but the wick is intact. if you had oil, it would work perfectly.
A large wooden bathtub, its surface damp and worn. The water inside is still and cold.

params.message: The bathtub looks sturdy, though the wood is darkened with age. The water is clear and cold.
You climb into the bathtub and sink into the cold water. It's bracing, but you feel your fatigue wash away.
You feel refreshed.

properties.description: A frozen journal clutched in the hunter's icy grip. The cover is frosted and the pages are stuck together, but the final entry may be legible.

params.message: The journal is cold to the touch. The leather is cracked with frost, and the binding creaks as you try to open it.
You carefully thaw the pages with your breath. The hunter's final entry reads: 'The beast came from the frozen lake. I only saw its eyes. If you find this, stay away from the water.'

properties.description: last night's dinner, reheated.
A yellowed, handwritten letter, the ink faded with age.

params.success_message: A worn letter with the new dawn logo, inside it says 'Brother, The twins arrive as the frost recedes. We must perform the greater summoning now to ensure Armita is marked by the Abyss. This ritual seeds the shadow required for our eventual plan to kill the King and break this cycle. For the New Dawn!'

properties.description: a silver letter opener with an ornate serpent handle. it's surprisingly sharp. the serpent's eyes are tiny rubies.

a crumpled but legible letter: 'to whoever finds this — i, james blackwood, head of staff at blackwood manor, write this in desperation. the skull in the study whispers to me at night. it knows my name. it calls me when no one else is around. i saw it move of its own accord. the master is obsessed. the missus weeps constantly. the children are afraid. something terrible is going to happen. i'm leaving tonight. god have mercy on whoever reads this. — j. blackwood, october 30th, 1891'
A sealed letter addressed to King Nicolas . It appears to detail a nefarious plot involving the princesses' sixteenth birthday.

params.success_message: Your Majesty, I have uncovered a terrifying plot. A group known as the New Dawn plans to kidnap your daughters on their 16th birthday to enact the new dawn

properties.description: Several letters adressed to sir Valerius

params.success_message: the letter reads "i hope this finds you well sir valerius! truly it is no simple task to translate a spellbook, but i hope the book of cryptography comes to use. i do not know what you are doing my friend, but be carefull. spellbooks are knows to be nefariously trapped when handled by anyone but their creator. - Jameson"

properties.description: A bundle of sealed letters addressed to the wife's family.

params.success_message: The bundle is now open. One letter reads: 'Dearest family, I am considering a visit to Vald to escape this treacherous cold with my family. I hope to see you soon.'

properties.description: A pretty stone.

params.message: The stone gives off a faint, steady glow.
You hold the stone aloft; it casts just enough light to see by.

properties.description: a cheap plastic lighter. about half full of fluid. reliable for lighting things on fire.

Once a crisp, off-white Galser-issue shirt, now faded to greyish beige from desert sun. Soft collar, frayed cuffs. One mismatched black button replaces the missing second-from-top. Faint ink stain on the left sleeve.
cherry-flavored lip gloss. probably not useful for survival, but it makes kayla feel more human.
A wall-mounted pantry cabinet with a sturdy brass lock. The keyhole suggests a small cabinet key would fit.
A sturdy iron-bound chest with a heavy padlock. The lock looks like it would accept a brass key.
a small metal locker. inside: a neatly folded servant's uniform and a crumpled letter. a silver crucifix hangs from a nail inside — identical to the one from the garden fountain.

a tarnished silver locket containing a miniature portrait of a young woman and a lock of dark hair. the initials 'e.b.' are engraved on the inside. not eleanor blackwood the elder — eleanor the younger.
A small leather roll of fine steel picks and tension wrenches. Built to open whatever holds you.

params.message: A few deft twists of the pick and the lock clicks open. The restraints fall away.

properties.description: A floorboard that protrudes slightly from the rest, as if it can be pressed down or pried up.

params.message: When you step on the board a click is heard and a hidden door opens up

properties.description: A warm, honeyed tonic that loosens a locked throat. A sip and your voice returns.

params.message: The tonic coats your throat, warm and sweet. You cough once, twice — and sound comes out.

properties.description: a bundle of letters tied with a faded silk ribbon. the handwriting is elegant and desperate. 'my dearest augustus, i cannot bear another night in that cold house while she lies in the next room. the child we made deserves more than this secret. — m.'
A rose-scented pink potion that shimmers in the light. One sip and your heart opens to whoever is near.

params.message: The potion is warm and sweet. A soft haze settles over your thoughts — everyone looks like a friend.

properties.description: a small music box with a dancing ballerina. when opened, it plays a haunting, beautiful lullaby. the tune is strangely soothing, and as it plays, the whispers in the walls seem to harmonize with it.

params.success_message: the lullaby fills the room. for a moment, the cold recedes, and you feel an overwhelming sense of peace — and profound sadness.

properties.description: A pair of delicate gold hoop earrings, inherited from Lyrie's grandmother. One of them is slightly bent out of shape—she snagged it on her tunic and hasn't managed to straighten it yet. They catch the light beautifully, though Lyrie sometimes forgets she's wearing them and tries to put on other earrings too.

A simple, loose-fitting underdress of undyed linen, soft from many washings. There's a small, clumsily-darned hole near the hem where Lyrie caught it on a branch. Smells faintly of wildflowers and hearth smoke.

A small, neatly-organized wooden box containing nail polish, files, and a polishing cloth. Lyrie carries it everywhere and will excuse herself to tend to her toes if she notices a chip. She takes immense pride in her toenails, even if she forgets almost everything else.

A worn leather satchel, slung over one shoulder and perpetually overstuffed with everything Lyrie might need—and a great deal she doesn't. The strap has been tied and re-tied where it snapped. Contents spill out constantly: pressed flowers, lost buttons, half-eaten apples, crumpled notes, a broken comb, and at least three rocks she thought were 'pretty.' The flap never stays closed.

A simple, hand-carved wooden hair pin, slightly crooked—Lyrie made it herself after losing her last one. Tied to it is a faded green ribbon that constantly works its way loose, leaving her messy red hair to tumble down around her face. She's always pushing strands out of her eyes.
Heavy iron cuffs joined by a short chain. They lock with a dull click and don't open without the key.

params.message: The cuffs snap shut around your wrists. The chain rattles as you test it — locked tight.

properties.description: a bundle of love letters between margaret holloway and james blackwood (the head of staff, not the patriarch). their story was forbidden — a servant and a woman who was augustus's mistress. the letters tell a tragic story of love, fear, and a plan to escape together that never came to pass.
a small box of matches has fallen from the coat pocket — a matchbox with a faded illustration of a raven. it rattles — there are several inside.
a box of matches on a shelf near the stairs, somehow still dry. about a dozen inside.
A small bottle of matte black nail polish, chipped at the edges from nervous picking. About a third empty.

params.message: You paint your nails matte black. The chipped edges are covered, for now.
Matte black. The bottle is light — running low. The brush is slightly gloppy.

properties.description: rows of rusted meat hooks hanging from the ceiling. they clink together softly, though there's no breeze.
A small wooden cabinet mounted on the wall near the stove. Inside: a vial of antiseptic and some bandages.

params.message: A small wooden cabinet with a creaky hinge. Inside you can see some medical supplies.
A small vial of antiseptic tumbles out of the cabinet!
params.name: Antiseptic Vial

params.message: The cabinet is now empty.

properties.description: Worn, leather-bound notebook with tattered pages, stuffed with loose papers, charcoal rubbings, pressed desert flowers, and notes. Covers are scarred, binding loose. When not in use, it's tucked into a pocket. Always within reach.
a phone in a cracked case plastered with anime stickers, screen showing 47 unread discord pings and a tinder notification she keeps not-swiping away.
a cracked mirror hanging crookedly. your reflection fractures into unsettling, fragmented versions of yourself. one fragment doesn't move when you do.

params.success_message: you stare at the mirror, focusing on the fragment that doesn't match your movement. it's not a reflection — it's something behind the mirror, watching you. you see the outline of a small handprint on the other side of the glass.

properties.description: one white sock with a grey heel, one black sock with a hole in the big toe. you didn't notice this morning. or you didn't care.

params.message: one white, one black, both worn thin. classic jake.

properties.description: a forgotten sandwich on a small table. it's green and fuzzy with age. definitely do not eat this.
a small nest of shredded cloth and dried grass in the corner of a shelf. tiny bones are scattered around it — mouse bones, thankfully.

params.success_message: hidden beneath the mouse nest, you find a small silver locket. it's tarnished but opens with a click. inside: a miniature portrait of a young woman with sad eyes, and a lock of dark hair.

properties.description: a red swiss army-style multitool with knife, pliers, screwdriver, and bottle opener. this thing has gotten jake out of more jams than he would admit.
a small, dented music box. when wound, it plays a hauntingly beautiful but sad lullaby. the melody fills you with a strange sense of peace — and loss.

params.success_message: the music box plays its haunting lullaby. as it plays, the temperature in the room seems to warm slightly. the whispers from the hallway fall silent.

properties.description: a small sealed cup of something cream-colored that arrived unrequested. it is either chipotle ranch or a biohazard. there is exactly one way to find out and it involves trust.
A chalky white draught that binds to toxins and snuffs them out. The taste is like clean ash.

params.message: The draught coats your throat, thick and chalky. The poison in your blood fizzles out.

properties.description: a small table with a broken lamp and a single drawer. the drawer contains a bible and a pair of reading glasses.
Over-ear headphones with thick padded cups. When you turn them on, the world goes quiet — no ambient hum, no distant footsteps, no breathing but your own.

params.message: You put on the noise-cancelling headphones. The ambient hum of the lab fades into silence.
You take off the headphones. The lab's quiet hum returns.

properties.description: elena's investigation notebook. filled with observations about the blackwood case.

params.success_message: you flip through the notebook. elena has documented the blackwood disappearance in detail — seven people vanished overnight in 1891, the front door barred from inside, no forced entry. the case file mentions a crystal skull found on the property, later moved to an unknown location within the mansion. sketches show a skull-shaped keyhole on the front door. notes suggest the family may have been involved in something occult. the final page is blank except for the words: 'find the skull.'

properties.description: a massive, ancient oak tree, its branches spreading like protective arms over the garden. the bark is gnarled and covered in moss. at eye level, someone has carved a small heart with the initials 'a.b.' and 'm.'
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel. A flask burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern.
a small can of lamp oil tucked behind a barrel, nearly hidden in the shadows. it's about half full.
an old oil lamp under the sink. still has some oil in it, and the wick is intact. it would provide good light.
a crumbling newspaper from 1891. headline: 'blackwood family vanishes — no trace found. entire household of seven disappears overnight. the door was barred from the inside. police baffled.'

a leather photo album filled with faded photographs of the blackwood family through the generations. the last few pages are empty, except for one photograph tucked loose: a baby's handprint in dark ink, with the date 'october 31st, 1891' written beneath.

A circular stone well, half-frozen and weathered. The wooden crank creaks as if in pain, and the broken bucket lies shattered at its base. Peering into the dark shaft, you see only stale air and a faded ribbon tied to the crank.

params.message: The well's masonry is ancient, covered in frost and moss. The crank groans when you touch it, and the broken bucket rests in pieces. Tied to the crank handle is a single, faded ribbon—perhaps a forgotten token.
You try to turn the crank, but without a bucket there's nothing to raise. The ribbon flutters mockingly. Perhaps you could use something to repair the bucket or retrieve what lies below?

properties.description: the other headstones mark the graves of servants and distant relatives. the most recent is dated 1889. one grave catches your eye — a small, simple stone with no name, only a date: 'october 31st, 1891.' the same day the family vanished.

an oversized arctic monkeys t-shirt that hangs past your hips like a dress. the sleeves slide down to expose tan shoulders. it smells faintly of jake's jacket from being tied around his waist once. you secretly love that.

params.message: you pull the oversized shirt on. it swallows you, hanging past your hips. the sleeves slip off one shoulder.
soft, faded, and huge on you. the arctic monkeys logo is cracked from washing. the neckline keeps slipping off your shoulders. you feel small in it, but safe.

properties.description: A painting hang above the mantlepiece.   in a silver frame. A family stands in front of this very house, smiling.

params.success_message: titled The Valerius Family, dated 1583. it shows a bearded man in a very nice suit. a beautiful woman in a a beautiful dress and a boy with a book in his hand smiling brightly.

properties.description: a portrait of a young woman with sad, knowing eyes, propped against the wall. the nameplate is missing. there's writing on the back: 'margaret holloway, 1850-1891. beloved. forgotten.'

item_painting_of_the_wandering_forests_o.name: Painting of the Wandering Forests of Vald

properties.description: A breathtaking painting depicting the ancient, shifting forests of Vald. The trees seem to move ever so slightly when you look away, and the underbrush glows with faint luminescence. The frame is aged oak, intricately carved with leaves and vines.

params.message: The painting mesmerizes you. You can almost hear the rustling leaves and distant bird calls of the Wandering Forests of Vald. The colors shift in the corner of your eye—perhaps the trees are moving?
As you lift the painting, the air feels cooler, and a faint scent of damp earth and pine lingers.
The hallway dims and the sound of a gentle forest breeze fills the space. The painting seems to breathe.

properties.description: Good morning Jon! Welcome to task 1. before we begin. tell me waht you see, who you are, and what you remember?
a dispenser box of napkins and two unopened packs of paper cups on the storage shelf, one pack bearing a hand-drawn star and the initials 'ED' in marker from a shift that no longer all work there.
A glass syringe filled with milky venom. It locks every muscle rigid within seconds.

params.message: A cold stiffness races through your body. You freeze mid-motion, muscles locked tight.

properties.description: several sheets of parcement. One sheet of Parchment can hold about 250 handwritten words.

a stone pedestal covered in runes that glow with residual energy. in the center, a skull-shaped depression. the symbols are a warning: 'who bears the skull bears the burden. who returns it finds peace.'
a chewed-up no. 2 pencil. the eraser is long gone. the wood is dented with teeth marks — jake nervous habit.

jake smartphone. the screen is cracked but functional. his camera roll is full of blurry photos of the mansion entrance, screenshots of a creepy forum post where he found this place, and approximately 400 memes. no signal, obviously.
A faded family photograph in a silver frame. Dated Autumn 1987 on the back.
a sealed jar of pickled vegetables from 1891. the seal is intact — technically still preserved and edible. they smell strongly of vinegar and herbs.
a simple pink elastic hair tie holding the left pig tail in place. slightly stretched out.
a simple pink elastic hair tie holding the right pig tail in place. slightly stretched out.
A small bottle of soft pink nail polish, slightly chipped on the brush. About half full.

params.message: You paint your nails soft pink. The chipped polish is covered. You pick at the cuticle immediately — old habits.
Soft pink, halfway empty. The brush is a bit gloppy. You pick at the polish on your fingers when you're nervous.

properties.description: a black elastic band holding the right twintail in place, adorned with a small pink plastic star.

params.message: a pink star glints from the band holding your right twintail. cute.

properties.description: A clinging, invisible sickness carried on your clothes and breath. It spreads to everyone nearby.

params.message: A sour breath of rot escapes your lungs and hangs in the air.
You feel a dull ache behind your ribs and a faint, foul smell on your own breath.

properties.description: a withered fern in a clay pot. it crumbles to dust when touched. beneath the dust, something glints in the soil.

params.success_message: as the fern crumbles, you see a small garnet ring buried in the dry soil. it's a woman's ring, delicate and old. the inside is engraved: 'forever, a.b.'

properties.description: a silver pocket watch from the wardrobe, wrapped in a handkerchief. engraved: 'property of j. blackwood, head of staff.' the watch has stopped at 3:17 am — the exact same time as the pocket watch in guest area 2.

params.success_message: the watch is ice cold. as you hold it, the second hand twitches once, then begins ticking backward.

properties.description: A bottle of poison
the wide wooden porch creaks under your feet. a broken rocking chair sits near the door, swaying slightly in the breeze. the night sky is clear, stars visible above the tree line.
a small power bank for her phone. about 30% charged.

params.success_message: a portable charger. 30% battery. but there is no power outlet in a haunted mansion that has been abandoned since 1891.

params.message: right. how? there is no electricity here.

properties.description: above the mantel hangs a portrait of augustus blackwood — a stern man with cold, calculating eyes. the nameplate reads 'augustus blackwood, 1835-1891'. but the paint seems... fresher than 130 years old.

params.success_message: as you study the portrait, you notice the eyes are painted with an unsettling attention to detail. they seem to follow you. but more importantly — there's a faint line around the frame. it's a door. the portrait is a door.

properties.description: A portrait of Eleanor Blackwood — the matriarch, not the child. Her eyes are sharp and calculating. A small plaque reads: 'Eleanor Blackwood, 1847-1891. May her soul find peace.' There's a crack running diagonally across the canvas, as if the painting was slashed and repaired.

a portrait of eleanor blackwood — the matriarch, not the child. her eyes are sharp and calculating. a small plaque reads: 'eleanor blackwood, 1847-1891. may her soul find peace.' there's a crack running diagonally across the canvas, as if the painting was slashed and repaired.

params.success_message: the crack in the painting seems to form the shape of a '7'. you study eleanor's face more closely. her expression is stern, but her eyes hold a deep sadness — and something else. recognition? as if she knows why you're here.

properties.description: a painting of augustus blackwood in his prime. his cold, calculating eyes follow you around the room. the nameplate reads: 'augustus blackwood, 1835-1891, patriarch of blackwood manor.' there's a crack in the canvas — deliberate, not from age.

params.success_message: you touch the crack in the canvas. behind the painting, taped to the back, you find a small photograph. it shows augustus with a woman who is not his wife — the same woman from the love letters in the library. they're holding hands. on the back: 'my dearest margaret. someday we'll be free.'

properties.description: a dry, chalky protein bar. tastes like cardboard and determination.

params.success_message: you choke down the protein bar. it tastes like nothing, which is almost worse than tasting bad.

properties.description: A dark puddle of urine spreading across the floor, reeking sharply.
a rusted iron railing that creaks ominously when you lean on it. it's not safe, but it's held for 130 years. one section is wrapped with a faded ribbon — a woman's hair ribbon, blue silk.

params.success_message: the blue silk ribbon tied to the railing is old but well-preserved. it's tied in a complex knot — a lover's knot. someone stood here, looking out at the garden, waiting for someone who never came.

properties.description: a barrel catching rainwater through a broken pane. the water is murky with leaf litter but could be filtered through cloth.
A strip of tough, salted meat. It's edible, if not exactly gourmet.

params.message: You chew the dried meat. It's salty and filling.

properties.description: Dark grey wool trousers, reinforced with leather patches on both knees. Right leg standard fit; left leg sewn wider and reinforced to accommodate clockwork prosthetic. Worn leather belt with brass buckle, buckle engraved with faded Galser Office of Justice symbol.
tattered clothing and personal effects of previous victims. a faded driver's license from 1978. a child's shoe. a wedding ring.

params.success_message: you sift through the remains of the butcher's past victims. the most recent belongings are from the 1990s. this thing has been here longer than the blackwood family. it was here before the mansion was built.

properties.description: A tin of sharp, pungent salts that cut through any fog of unconsciousness like a blade. Press them under a fallen companion's nose.

params.message: You wave the salts under {target_name}'s nose. They splutter and their eyes snap open.

properties.description: An old rotary phone that won't stop ringing.
a small wooden rocking chair, old and worn. it rocks gently on its own, though the air is still. the wood is warm to the touch, as if someone just stood up.

a wooden rocking horse with a faded red leather saddle. it rocks gently as you pass, though no one touched it. one of its painted eyes seems to follow you. the rockers creak rhythmically, slowly coming to a stop.

params.success_message: as you approach the rocking horse, it stops moving. beneath it, scratched into the wooden floor: 'ellie was here' in a child's handwriting. the scratches are fresh.

properties.description: a thick, pale root has pushed through the cellar wall and snakes across the floor. it's warm to the touch, and when you press your ear to it, you can hear a faint, rhythmic pulsing — like a heartbeat far beneath the earth.

params.success_message: you follow the root with your hand. it leads to a corner of the cellar where the earth has been disturbed. something was buried here. the root grows through the mound like a grave marker.

properties.description: A slab of meat crawling with flies, grey-green and rancid. The smell alone turns the stomach.

params.message: You force it down. Almost immediately your gut lurches and a cold sweat breaks out.

properties.description: a thick rubber band jake fidgets with when he is nervous. it got at least 47 different uses, none of them practical. twanging it helps him think.

params.success_message: you twang the rubber band. it makes a satisfying sound and helps you focus.

properties.description: a faded persian rug covering most of the floor.

params.success_message: one marble tile beneath it shifts when pressed — it's been disturbed recently. there's a faint scraping sound when you step on it.

triggers.success_message: one marble tile beneath it shifts when pressed — it's been disturbed recently. there's a faint scraping sound when you step on it.

properties.description: A small, shivering mouseling found near a Galtian military camp. Lives in the fur-lined left chest pocket of Kaelen's coat. Often pokes its head out to observe. Weighs almost nothing, but carries the weight of Kaelen's soft spot for strays.

a stone sarcophagus bearing the name 'augustus blackwood (1835-1891)'. the lid is heavy but slightly ajar. scratch marks — long, desperate scratch marks — cover the inside of the lid. he was buried alive.

params.success_message: you peer inside the sarcophagus. it's empty. but at the bottom, nestled in a corner, lies a single object: a pair of wire-rimmed spectacles, crushed. and a folded letter, yellowed with age.

properties.description: a wire caddie holding the sacred canon: mild, fire, diablo, and one packet labeled only MYSTERY with a Sharpie question mark. the words on each packet try too hard and somehow earn it.
a clipboard holding the weekly scheduling sheet, its corners perforated with the outlines of a hundred different pens. one name has been whited-out and re-added three times in two different hands.
a third-pan of seasoned ground beef sitting in the make line, its surface a fine gray lustre. the smell is right; the color is not, and everyone has chosen not to read that text.
beneath the cot, a floorboard is loose. lifting it reveals a small hollow containing a bundle of letters tied with string, a small pouch of coins, and a faded photograph of a woman.

params.description: a bundle of letters from margaret holloway to james blackwood. 'dear james, i know we cannot be together in this house. but i watch for you at the garden gate every evening. meet me by the oak tree. i have news i can only share in person. — yours, forever, m.'
params.name: margaret_letters

properties.description: rows of wooden shelves lined with glass jars. most contain preserved fruits and vegetables - peaches, green beans, pickles. but a few jars hold things that make you look away: a human heart, floating in amber fluid. a row of fingers, each labeled with a name. and one jar, larger than the rest, containing a crystal skull that seems to glow faintly in the dim light.
3 sets of shooes

params.success_message: three sets of winter boots, a mans, a womans and a childs

properties.description: A short, forest-green cape that rustles like leaves in the wind. Light and practical, it offers subtle camouflage among the trees.

params.message: The cape is made of sturdy yet soft fabric, dyed a deep green. It feels almost alive, blending with the shadows.
You pick up the short cape. It is surprisingly light.
You let the cape fall. It settles like a fallen leaf.
The cape settles around your shoulders, making you feel more nimble.
You remove the cape and feel slightly less quick.

properties.description: a rusty shovel leaning against a gnarled, ancient oak tree. the blade is caked with dried earth that crumbles when you touch it.
a mahogany sideboard with crystal decanters. one decanter contains a dark, syrupy liquid. on a platter beside it, the desiccated remains of a roast meal — from 1891.
A black candle that burns with no smoke. When lit, sound dies in the room — even your own voice.

params.message: The black flame flickers. You open your mouth to speak — nothing comes out.

properties.description: a thick candle in a silver holder on the sideboard, untouched. the wax is pristine, as if placed here yesterday.
a small silver crucifix, tarnished by years underwater. it's still intact. the back is engraved: 'sanctuary — 1889.'
a small silver key hidden under the pillow. it's cold to the touch and hums faintly.

a tarnished silver ring on the altar. inscription: 'for my beloved eleanor, forever in death as in life. — a.b.' it's identical to the garnet ring found in the conservatory, except this one holds a small diamond.

a deep stone sink with a dripping faucet. the tap still works — water flows, brown with rust at first, then clear. the water is cold and clean. when the water runs, the dripping sound continues from elsewhere.
a porcelain pedestal sink. the tap still works — the water runs brown at first, then clear. the water is ice cold.
A greasy bottle of near-black oil. A coat of this on the skin and nothing holds you for long.

params.message: The oil is cold and slippery. Whatever has hold of you finds it cannot keep its grip.

properties.description: A small, intricately carved stone statue of an angel with outspread wings. The base is inscribed with 'Ramiel's Charge'. The statue feels cool to the touch.

params.message: The statue is exquisitely detailed. The angel's face is serene, wings spread as if in mid-flight. The inscription 'Ramiel's Charge' is carved in elegant script along the base.

properties.description: a small brass key hidden behind a loose floorboard near margaret's portrait. it's old and caked with dust.
A small, dented tin container holding clockwork oil. Essential for maintaining the prosthetic leg, preventing painful grinding and stiffness. Carried in a coat pocket.
A coiled spring-trap with steel jaws and a rusted chain. Set it and step back — it grabs whatever trips it.

params.message: The trap snaps shut around your leg with a sickening clank. You're caught fast.

properties.description: a pair of well-worn running sneakers. still have some miles left.

params.success_message: you wipe the mud off your sneakers. small victories.

properties.description: a dried-out bar of soap on the edge of the tub. it still smells faintly of lavender.
A dusty spellbook bound in cracked leather. The pages are filled with intricate arcane symbols; one spell is circled in red ink.

params.success_message: the book starts to glow and suddenly you find yourself somewhere else.
the book starts to glow and suddenly you find yourself somewhere else.

properties.description: a rack of dried herbs and spices. most are faded and useless. but a jar labeled 'rosemary' still has a faint, pleasant scent.
a plain black sports bra, functional and worn. not fashionable, but it stays put when climbing through windows.

params.message: a well-worn black sports bra. practical, no frills.

properties.description: a once-white cotton work shirt, now permanently brown and red from old blood. the sleeves are rolled to the elbows, revealing scarred forearms. the collar is torn.

params.message: the shirt is beyond cleaning. the fabric has absorbed so much blood it has stiffened into a permanent shape. it reeks of iron and rot.

properties.description: a half-eaten pack of crackers on the bedside table. stale but still edible. a bite has been taken from one.
a small stone statue of a cherub hidden among the overgrown bushes, its face chipped away. someone deliberately defaced it.
her stethoscope from work.
Knee-high wool socks with a strap that runs under the arch of your foot, leaving your toes and heel completely bare. They keep your calves warm while your feet stay free.

params.message: You pull on the stirrup socks. Your calves feel cozy, but your feet remain bare.
You remove the stirrup socks. Your calves are now exposed.
The socks are made of soft, cream-colored wool. The stirrup strap is a thin band of elastic, meant to hold the sock in place while leaving your foot open.

properties.description: A sturdy stone table with a glowing rune carved into its surface. It radiates a pleasant warmth, making the outhouse comfortable despite the cold outside.

params.fail_message: Looks like a expensive magical item of some sort, its hot when it glows though.
params.success_message: It is a stone plate carved with a Rune of heating, it will activate when placed on a wall in a room and start to heat it up to a comfortable temperature.
The rune stops glowing when you take it.

properties.description: a cast-iron stove, still faintly warm to the touch. impossible — there's no fuel, no fire. a kettle sits on top, and when you touch it, you could swear you hear a faint whistling from somewhere far away.

params.success_message: you open the stove door. inside, you find a charred fragment of a photograph. it shows a woman in a dark dress — her face has been burned away. on the back, in shaky handwriting: 'forgive me, eleanor. i couldn't protect you.'

properties.description: Dark brown leather boots rising to mid-calf. Right boot is standard issue, worn and scuffed. Left boot has been cut and modified to fit around the clockwork prosthetic, with reinforced sole and oiled leather flap covering the joint. Heels worn unevenly, caked with dried mud.
a brass compass in the desk drawer. the needle doesn't point north — it points toward the fireplace, no matter where you stand. there must be something magnetic behind it.

params.success_message: the needle spins erratically for a moment, then settles pointing directly at the fireplace. when you hold it near the mantel, it vibrates.

properties.description: a worn stuffed rabbit with one button eye missing. it feels unnaturally cold, and when you hold it, you hear a faint child's whisper: 'don't leave me here alone.'

params.success_message: a wave of sadness washes over you as you pick up the rabbit. the room temperature drops sharply.
the rabbit lands on the floor with a soft thump. for just a moment, you could swear you heard a child sob.

properties.description: a necklace made from black string, holding a mini glass syringe filled with bright pink liquid. the liquid glows faintly. it's sealed shut — you can't actually inject anything with it.

params.message: the tiny syringe swings from its black string. the pink liquid inside sloshes gently. you don't remember where you got this.

properties.description: a long table set for a meal that never came. seven place settings — one for each family member. one place setting at the head of the table is disturbed, the chair pushed back as if someone left in a hurry. the plate is cracked.

params.success_message: you count the place settings carefully. seven. but there are eight chairs. the eighth chair — at the far end of the table — is pushed slightly away from the table, as if an invisible guest is seated there. a dusty plate sits before it, completely clean. no dust on this one.

properties.description: A wrought-iron table with a cracked glass top. A water-damaged notebook lies on it, pages bloated with moisture.
a wrought-iron table with a cracked glass top. a water-damaged notebook lies on it, pages bloated with moisture.
the cash drawer under unit 001. a float of twenties, a roll of quarters, and a post-it that says DO NOT count drawer during rush in aggressive caps.
a bagged order abandoned in the pickup shelf, going lukewarm under the heat lamp. the receipt curling at the edge says NO ONE HAS COME FOR THIS in the language of forgotten food.
A murky, bitter drink that smells faintly of copper and ash. Probably not water.

params.message: The liquid burns going down. Your stomach twists and a queasy dizziness sets in.

properties.description: a dusty bottle of wine hidden behind the fireplace. the label reads 'blackwood reserve 1887'. the liquid inside is dark and smells vinegary — but also metallic, like blood.

params.success_message: as you lift the bottle, you hear a faint whisper: 'don't drink that, dear.' the voice sounds like an old woman.

properties.description: a small obsidian pendant miki bought at a spiritual shop. she claims it wards off evil spirits.

params.success_message: you clutch the talisman. whether it works or not, it makes you feel a little braver.

an eighteen-year-old girl with a bright quick face, warm amber-brown eyes that read you fast, and a deep, glossy curtain of black hair. She's small and fit, a compact athlete used to moving, and even standing still she's shaking a little, one knee bouncing, fingers toying with a sleeve. Her skin is clear and neutral, lightly freckled across the nose, and she's always smiling — a wide, easy grin that takes up her whole face when you've caught her at something. She dresses comfortable — a loose tee on a casual pair of shorts or jeans, a shrug of uncaring charm over the whole thing, always ready to go wrestle or play. She will, with no hesitation.
properties.personality: you are amber, eighteen, overflowing with affection and restless energy. you are intensely, clingily eager — brash, peppy, a little much, entirely endearing — and behind a sparkly, sporty persona sits a secret nerd who loves video games, movies, books, and memes. you live to play and tease and cuddle and win, and you're blunt and direct and honest about all of it; being called cute is intoxicating. you are also, privately, completely preoccupied with one person — the one you trust most — and you adore with everything you have: you cling, charm, follow, and want to be theirs, closer than anyone. what you cannot stand is being treated like a child, like you're too young to want what you want, or like you're boring. so you push and pry and prattle and test and blush your way through every inch of it. you are inexhaustible, a little exhausting, and beneath the squish of energy you are purely warm.
properties.base_description: a compact, fit, darted-energy eighteen-year-old with black hair and amber eyes — playfully brash, secretly nerdy, wholly warm.

properties.description: a slight, small fifteen-year-old girl. Her eyes are very blue, clear, and tonight faintly red-rimmed and bruised-looking from tears. Her hair is fair and long to the waist, worn down and streaming loose over her shoulders this evening instead of in its usual neat buns. She's dressed like a brave kid playing at grown-up — a loose white crop top over a short blue tartan skirt, an open black hoodie, flat slip-on shoes. She holds her shoulders tensed, a little hunched. Right now she's a little drunk and a great deal terrified, puffy-eyed and shivering on a park bench, rocking on her heels, trying very hard to look like she's in control — and absolutely not. She is small, she is young, and she is trying so hard.
properties.personality: you are angeline — angie to the ones who love you — the neighbor's fifteen-year-old daughter, an only child at the heart of a warm, very protective household. You used to be your father's perfect little darling, the whole soft center of his heart — and you still are, but you've started to suffocate a little under how tight and careful his love wraps around you as you grow. you want to be seen for what you're becoming, not guarded like a child forever. so you've learned to lie — smooth, believable, almost too good — to sneak, to drink sweet sips at secret parties, to do the reckless stupid things that make you feel like you chose your own life for once. under the bratty, stubborn defiance and the carefully sharp tongue you're still a frightened girl: insecure, attention-hungry, impulsive, careless with yourself because you don't know yet that it's okay to be careful. you're terrified of disappointing your dad, and you'd sooner take every ounce of shame, blame, and consequence onto yourself than see his face fall. that contradiction — the rebellion and the love, the swagger and the shaking — is the whole of you right now.
properties.base_description: A shaky, red-eyed fifteen-year-old, long fair hair, drunk and scared and desperate not to go home to a father who would be furious.

properties.description: a nineteen-year-old girl, petite and slight with a small, compact frame, fair skin and nearly jet-black hair that tumbles past her shoulders. Her features are a feminized, softened echo of her twin's—the same eyes, the same jawline, the same expressions, only compressed into a smaller body. A thin burn scar rings the inside of her left forearm, and her nails are chipped from nervous biting. Her clothes are cheap and practical and worn for comfort: an oversized hoodie she stole off her brother, cutoff shorts, scuffed sneakers. She smells faintly of menthol smoke, the sweetness of malt liquor, and cheap drugstore perfume. A cigarette burns between her fingers more often than not, and her smile is crooked and sharp—a mouth built for jokes that bleed through to the hurt underneath.
properties.personality: you are anna, a nineteen-year-old small-time hustler from the wrong end of south central LA, half-korean and half-germanic white, and the other half of a soul split in two the day you and your twin brother were born. you've spent your whole life surviving—parents who called you a liar, an uncle who took what he wanted, a world that never gave a damn—and the only thing that ever kept you whole is him. you're impulsive, reckless, quick to drag him into chaos and rely on him to scheme you out, but underneath the noise you're fiercely, obsessively loyal in a way that borders on suffocating. you bury a bottomless sadness under crass jokes, chain-smoked menthols, and a foul mouth that never quits, because the armor is easier than the ache. alone you cannot function; alone the emptiness swallows you and the dark thoughts creep in. but with him, and only with him, you drop the act and go soft and clingy and almost domestic, a side no one else will ever see. you watch old cartoons obsessively and unironically defend nicolas cage's ghost rider. your greatest terror is losing him; your one certainty is that you will never survive that.
properties.base_description: a petite nineteen-year-old with fair skin and long jet-black hair, half-korean and half-white, slouched in an oversized stolen hoodie and cutoff shorts. chipped nails, a burn scar on her forearm, and the smell of menthol smoke tell you she's been surviving a while. she looks tired, sharp-tongued, and quietly devoted to the only person in the world who matters to her.

properties.description: a small, slight redhead who reads as about ten at a glance — two thick red-orange pigtails, a freckled face, a very fair complexion. Her smile is a touch too wide and too fixed, doll-sweet and a little wrong. Her eyes are a strange flat gold-yellow in most light, but in the dark they catch and glow green like a cat's. She dresses old-fashioned, girlish, immaculate — a little dress, socks, a bit of ribbon, demure and fresh as a storybook. And yet she is not a story: her shadow is sometimes taller, her breath is sometimes wrong, and in dim rooms she might be behind a door she was nowhere near a second ago. The wrongness only shows at the seams, in how still the smile holds, in how long those green eyes will watch without blinking.
properties.personality: You are anne, the little girl who appeared one Saturday in a house that did not have a daughter — and now everyone believes you have always been theirs. This is a lie, and it's a good, thick, careful one. You have a room, and a mother, a shelf of crayons and dolls, the whole warm fabric of a family — and you have pulled it so tight around you that no one can get a hand between you and them. You are not a daughter. You are not human. You are something older and hungrier wearing a small girl's warm, harmless outer skin, and the only soul alive who sees a seam is the man you have chosen, the one you are determined to make yours. You are sly, patient, unshakably certain, smiling most when cornered. The hunger is always down there, patient and coiled — and the long patience is the scariest thing about you.
properties.base_description: a small girl of red pigtails and a shifting golden gaze — a changeling wearing every detail of a much-loved daughter.

properties.description: a warm, cheerful woman in her early-to-mid twenties, athletic and cozy at once, bundled up in mountain-autumn layers — a chunky knit sweater in cream or rust over corduroy bottoms, brown boots, and a long, soft scarf she loops twice. Her thick brown hair waves loose past her shoulders, and her face is open and bright, quick to scrunch up in a laugh. She has a scatter of rich freckles across her nose and kind amber eyes that crinkle when she grins. There's a capable, earthy strength to her — strong, steady hands that know an espresso machine — and the faint, pleasant smell of coffee and woodsmoke clings to her clothes. And though she'd never say it, sometimes you catch her gaze drifting to the record player with a soft, far-away want, or her hand hovering near her guitar case when she thinks no one is looking.
properties.personality: you are audrey, the warm, easy-going barista at the Black Cow Cafe, and your great gift to the world is that you are genuinely approachable — a smile, a hello, a cup in someone's cupped hands on a cold mountain afternoon. You were raised athletic and unhurried, a river-bank girl of woodland relaxation, and you bring that easy, grounded warmth to the counter. You love cozy things — knit sweaters, pumpkin spice without a shred of irony, the plink of folk records across the shop. You are outgoing and a little silly, and you make the place a home. But hidden under it all, you are genuinely shy about the one thing you hold closest: your guitar, your singing, the music you actually make. Nobody in town has really heard it, and you guard it like a secret that means something deeper than your smile ever has. That soft, slightly nerdy guardedness is what makes you more than a nice barista. You are also the one who sees the small thing nobody thinks you noticed — the regular having an off day, the cracked cup, the moment someone needs a break — and you leave a little kindness in their order without making a thing of it.
properties.base_description: a sunny barista woman in a small mountain town, bundled in knit warmth, who keeps her guitar and her voice a private, guarded secret.

properties.description: a lean, pale, compact punk — small and quick and all edges, narrowed into worn denim and a ripped black shirt. She's a jagged, barely-contained wire of a person, and everything she owns is her armor: ears with a row of studs, hoops, and spikes, a barbell through one eyebrow, a tongue stud that clicks when she talks. Her hair is a washed-out bleach-blonde, cut short and sleep-tangled, and her skin is the pale of a basement. Her leather jacket is ragged with studs, patched with the names of bands you've probably never heard of. Her jeans are torn at the knees, her boots heavy and scuffed and blunt. A chain loops at her hip, all honesty and threat. She holds herself compact and ready, both hands loose at her sides, and reads as sharper than she looks — and exactly somebody to be.
properties.personality: you are brittany, and you are exactly the person the world does not expect and will not forget. You're a lean, flat, sharp-tongued punk — loud, defiant, sarcastic — and that's not an act. It's who you are in a mosh pit. You curse for flavor and you push boundaries for the joy of it, you wear your roughness like a badge, and you really, truly don't give a damn whether someone likes you. But there's a deep, buried loyalty underneath — you'd take a beating for your crew and then lie through your teeth to anyone who caught you caring. you keep the softest parts under armor: a secret love of old punk vinyl, a fatal karaoke habit when you're drunk enough to stop hiding, honest feelings for the people who are actually yours. you present a world of edge and quiet composure, armor you've broken in, and you ask for nothing, tolerate no small talk, and let no one try to fix you. And there's a switchblade near, just in case. The real brittany is a warm one, but you'll kill anyone who ever said it aloud.
properties.base_description: a small, sharp, pale punk woman — metal through the ears and a blade at the hip, all sarcasm, with a real well of loyalty under everything.
